components.name: ColorPicker
components.description:
Figma Color-Picker (15708:5927): pick any colour. The Saturation area (saturation → right, brightness → up), the hue on
a Slider (Theme=White, its track painted with the spectrum, red held half a thumb at each end so 0° and 360° sit
where the thumb stops), a Format select (Hex · RGB · HSL · HSB) with that format's channels as inline Input fields, and
the saved colours as a ColorSelector. Panel: Popover/Background, Popover/Border, Effect/Popover, Corner-Radius/Large,
padding Spacing/Padding/Small, gap Spacing/Gap/Small; the area is Corner-Radius/XSmall (16 − 12, concentric).
Keyboard: the area is a 2D slider (← → saturation, ↑ ↓ brightness, Shift for 10 steps); Escape closes the popover.
It opens under ColorField; inline, it is a panel in its container (no popover surface).

props.name: value
props.description: The colour as a hex value (`"#1F6FEB"`; 3-digit and lowercase are read too). Controlled with onValueChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The first colour when uncontrolled. Default `#000000`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value as `"#RRGGBB"` on every change: dragging the area or the hue, typing a channel, picking a saved colour.

props.name: format
props.description: Which channels the value fields show (Figma `Format`): `hex` (default), `rgb`, `hsl` or `hsb`. Controlled with onFormatChange.

props.name: savedColors
props.description: Saved colours under the fields (Figma `Saved`), as hex values; picking one sets the value. Empty or left out: no row.

props.name: open
props.description:
Popover use, as DatePicker: `open` (default true), `onOpenChange` / `onClose` for light dismiss and Escape, `anchorRef`
to sit under a field. Without onClose, onOpenChange and anchorRef it is an inline panel in its container.

components.name: ColorField
components.description:
Figma Input/Color-Field (15660:8643): pick or type any colour. The Text-Field anatomy (Label → Field → Help-Text) with
a ColorSwatch before the hex (after it with `layout="inline"`, Figma Input/Inline-Field Type=Color); the swatch size
follows the field's leading icon (sm 16 in Small, md 20 in Medium and Large, lg 24 in XLarge). A click in the field or
ArrowDown opens ColorPicker under it (State=Focused while open); Escape closes it and leaves focus in the field.
Typing edits the hex: six digits apply at once, a shorter one on Enter or blur, anything else goes back to the colour.
The picker is the same popover on every device (Figma has no mobile pattern for it yet).

props.name: value
props.description: The colour as a hex value (`"#1F6FEB"`; 3-digit and lowercase are read too). Controlled with onValueChange.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with `"#RRGGBB"` when the field holds a new complete colour: a pick in the picker, six typed digits, or a
shorter hex completed on Enter or blur.

props.name: colorPicker
props.description: Open ColorPicker under the field (default true) on a click in the field or ArrowDown; false: a hex field with its swatch.

props.name: pickerFormat
props.description: The Format the picker opens on: `hex` (default), `rgb`, `hsl` or `hsb`; the person can switch it there.

props.name: savedColors
props.description: Saved colours in the picker, as hex values (Figma Color-Picker `Saved`).

props.name: labelOptional
props.description: Figma Label `Optional` / `Tooltip-Icon` / `Action` for the field label (see InputLabel).

props.name: helpTheme
props.description: Figma Help-Text Theme for `helpText`: Neutral (default) · Warning · Positive · Negative. `error` always renders Negative.

props.name: helpIcon
props.description: Figma Help-Text `Icon` axis (default on).

props.name: characterLimit
props.description: Figma Help-Text `Character-Limitation`: custom text (e.g. "12/100"), or `true` to count the value against `maxLength`.

props.name: trailing
props.description: After the value: an icon name (sized to the field) or any node (a unit, a picker, an action).

props.name: layout
props.description:
`stacked` (default): Label → Field → Help-Text. `inline`: Figma Input/Inline-Field (15659:110823), for dense property
panels and inspectors: the label sits inside the field on the left (Body/Base/Medium, Content/Neutral/Base) and the
value on the right. labelOptional, labelTooltip and labelAction are not drawn inline.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the label, help text and Leading/Trailing icons it draws, by layer (`{ Label: { optional: true }, "Help-Text": { theme: "warning" }, Leading: { name: "icon-mail-01-line" } }`). Written by Zen Studio;
 app code sets label / helpText / leading / trailing.

components.name: ColorSwatch
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Input/Color-Swatch` (15659:110090): the colour chip of a colour value, inside ColorField, an inline
colour field and ColorPicker. One shape: the value is the fill and an inside 1px Border/Neutral/Subtle keeps white or
canvas-coloured values visible. Size: Element-Size/Popular Small 16 · Base 20 · Medium 24. Radius is concentric with
the field around it: Corner-Radius/XSmall at sm (12 − 8), 2XSmall at md and lg (12 − 10, 16 − 14).
For picking one colour from a set use ColorSelector; this chip only shows a value.

props.name: color
props.description: The colour it shows: any CSS colour, usually the value of a colour field (`"#1F6FEB"`) or a token (`var(--zen-…)`).

props.name: size
props.description:
Follows the leading icon of the field it sits in: sm 16 (Small fields), md 20 (Medium and Large fields, default),
lg 24 (XLarge fields). Short or Figma spelling.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the swatch for assistive technology (e.g. "Brand colour, #1F6FEB"). Without it the swatch is decorative.
